test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The population of a district is 360000, out of which 231000 are males. 66% of the population is literate. If 66% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate? .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the **Total Literacy Rate** is 66% and the **Male Literacy Rate** is also 66%.

By logic of **weighted averages**, if the overall average and one group average are identical, the second group average must also be the same.

Net deviation method: 66% (Total) = [Male % × 66% + Female % × x%] / 100%

Since Male Literacy = Total Literacy = 66%, then Female Literacy must be 66%.

**∴ The correct answer is 66%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96115f96b83dc5fa326ad86fcea289ca714e15f2a7efef8699489f5d3a8c49cf.png] 

**Given:**

Total Population = 3,60,000

Number of Males = 2,31,000

⇒ Number of Females = 3,60,000 − 2,31,000 = 1,29,000

Total Literate People = 66% of 3,60,000

⇒ Total Literate = 0.66 × 3,60,000 = 2,37,600

Literate Males = 66% of 2,31,000

⇒ Literate Males = 0.66 × 2,31,000 = 1,52,460

Literate Females = Total Literate − Literate Males

⇒ Literate Females = 2,37,600 − 1,52,460 = 85,140

Female Literacy % = (Literate Females ÷ Total Females) × 100

⇒ Female Literacy % = (85,140 ÷ 1,29,000) × 100 = 66%

**∴ The correct answer is 66%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Rule

If the average of the whole group is **A**, and the average of one sub-group is also **A**, then the average of the remaining sub-group must be **A** regardless of the ratio of group sizes.

Percentage Base Change

Always identify the correct **denominator (base)** when calculating group-specific percentages. For female literacy, the base is the number of **females**, not the total population.</p
